description.en: Lumen is a sales CRM for B2B sales teams, distributors, and logistics companies: move deals through a pipeline, keep customer profiles, follow up on invoices, hit monthly targets, and plan projects, meetings, and reports.
description.id: Lumen adalah CRM penjualan untuk tim sales B2B, distributor, dan perusahaan logistik: gerakkan deal di pipeline, simpan profil pelanggan, tagih invoice, kejar target bulanan, serta atur proyek, jadwal, dan laporan.
